title: Goutham Nanda
desc: An emotionless man lives off his father's wealth. He learns a lesson when he runs into a poor man and decides to swap his life with him.

title: Viswasam
desc: Thooku Durai, a strong and respected village leader, faces personal struggles as he tries to reunite with his estranged wife Niranjana and daughter, all while confronting challenges from his past.

title: Arjun S/O Vyjayanthi
desc: Arjun, a gangster, learns that a terrorist wants to take revenge from his mother, who is an IPS officer. In order to protect her, he strives to overcome all the odds.

title: Magic Oven
desc: A renowned chef shares and demonstrates the method to prepare various delicious recipes that can be easily made at home.
Sethuraman, a scientist, invents a time-travelling gadget that his evil twin Athreya wants to get hold of. Soon, a bitter battle arises between Sethuraman's son and Athreya.

title: Kochi Rajavu
desc: Tragedy strikes when Unni accidentally kills his lover's cousin, resulting in his imprisonment.

title: Sivakasi
desc: Muthappa is forced to leave his house at a young age for a crime that his older brother, Udayappa, has committed. When he returns home, he learns about his brother's antics and decides to punish him.
